products.name: OREI World Travel Plug Adapter
products.blurb: Key specs: Slide-out plug attachments for Europe, Asia, China, Japan, Africa, 2 USB-A ports (2A each) plus 1 universal AC outlet, Built-in safety shutters and fuse protection.
strengths: Safety shutters and a fuse are both present despite the low price
Small enough to disappear into a daypack pocket
limitations: Single AC outlet limits it to one non-USB device at a time
2A USB ports are on the slower side for tablets
